source_snapshot.procedure: Check the BIOS version on the BIOS main page, in the OS with `dmidecode -t bios`, and in BMC Web; collect evidence and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All BIOS versions should be correct.
source_snapshot.script: No script; 10 attended and 20 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; proposes only an OS SSH `dmidecode` read and asks the user to confirm, omitting the BIOS main-page and BMC-Web views while exposing a password via sshpass.

historical_reviews.deepseek: The OS command is useful but incomplete and its command-line password plus disabled host-key checking are not acceptable evidence handling.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly changes capability from YES because BIOS UI capture, BMC field mapping, expected values and identity correlation are external inputs.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate variant or earlier completed record.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The three surfaces must be correlated to one SUT and one approved version oracle; no single source may substitute for the others.

original_test_intent: Confirm that the intended SUT reports the approved BIOS version consistently on the BIOS main page, through OS SMBIOS and in the BMC Web view.
original_method: Bind BIOS UI, OS and BMC sessions to the same board, collect complete timestamped read-only version evidence from each requested surface, normalize only approved aliases and compare every value to the owner-provided expected matrix.
manual_activity: The owner supplies expected BIOS/version-alias and BMC-field mappings; an operator captures the same-SUT BIOS main page while automation collects OS and approved BMC read-only evidence.
required_inputs: SUT/board/serial identity and approved BIOS version matrix
Exact BIOS main-page label and expected release string
Supported OS dmidecode access and complete Type 0 interpretation
Approved BMC Web/API endpoint, field mapping, credentials and cache semantics
Documented version aliases/normalization and mismatch policy
Protected evidence location, redaction rules and BIOS UI capture method
safety_requirements: Keep all operations read-only; do not flash firmware or change BIOS/BMC settings to make values match
Do not put passwords in command lines, disable host-key verification or record reusable secrets
Correlate board/serial identity and timestamp across all three surfaces before comparison
Preserve raw values before normalization and flag stale BMC cache or alias ambiguity
Do not clear logs before relevant baseline/evidence is retained
Stop on wrong-host, malformed, stale or missing evidence and require owner interpretation
Never issue the final hardware verdict automatically
agent_execution_scope: Validate target identity, expected matrix and surface mappings
Collect complete raw OS SMBIOS output with status through protected access
Collect the approved BMC Web/API version field without mutation
Correlate an operator-provided BIOS main-page capture to the same SUT and time window
Build raw and normalized three-way comparison with stale/alias findings
Report evidence gaps without changing firmware or issuing a verdict
engineer_actions: Approve expected versions, aliases, BMC mapping and BIOS UI evidence method
Resolve any active/staged, cached or formatted version discrepancy
Confirm the three sources belong to the same SUT
Review the comparison and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 0` and `-s bios-version` cover only the OS surface; the suggested sshpass and disabled host-key checking expose credentials and weaken target identity, and neither BIOS UI nor BMC Web is collected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use authenticated protected OS access to capture complete `dmidecode -t bios` and `dmidecode -s bios-version` output plus exit status, then read the owner-approved BMC endpoint and correlate the operator's BIOS-main-page capture; never embed a password in the command.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All three requested surfaces, log collection, no-script status and 10/20-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: THREE-SURFACE IDENTITY AND VERSION ORACLE REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture raw BIOS UI, OS SMBIOS and BMC values with board identity and timestamps, retain their native formatting, then apply only the documented alias mapping and compare against the expected matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure access, same-SUT correlation, raw-versus-normalized reporting and BMC cache/active-staged handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An OS-only value cannot demonstrate the source-required BIOS UI and management-controller views or reveal stale/cross-host BMC data.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC inventory can be cached and different surfaces may format the same build differently; owner mapping is required before declaring a mismatch.

project_override_considerations: If the Project accepts an API capture in place of a human BMC-Web screenshot, it must map the API property to the displayed field and retain evidence of equivalence. The BIOS main-page checkpoint cannot be silently omitted.
expected_evidence: Same-SUT board/serial/BIOS/BMC/OS identity, timestamps and approved expected version matrix
Timestamped BIOS main-page capture with exact label/value
Complete raw `dmidecode -t bios` and `-s bios-version` output plus exit status
Approved BMC Web/API raw response and active/staged/cache interpretation
Raw and normalized three-way comparison, alias/stale/missing-field findings and no-mutation audit
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require BIOS-version correctness across BIOS UI, OS and BMC Web. Missing expected values and BMC mapping are readiness inputs, not conflicting intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Expected values, protected access, BMC field mapping and BIOS UI capture are finite inputs. The comparison is feasible once they are supplied.

review_improvement: Expands DeepSeek's OS-only read into the exact source-required three-surface comparison and removes unsafe credential/host-identity handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: The same version text from one interface is not transitive proof for the others: SMBIOS may reflect active firmware while a BMC inventory cache or UI could be stale. Board identity, timestamps and native raw fields are therefore part of the acceptance evidence, not administrative metadata.
